Synopsis:
As August 2026 closes, the S&P 500 sits ~1% below its all-time high, up 12%+ YTD, supported by strong AI-driven earnings (Nvidia +70% revenue forecast). Key near-term catalysts are the August jobs report (Sept 4, consensus +58K, unemployment 4.1%) and Broadcom's earnings. New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has shifted market pricing toward a September rate hike (57% probability), as inflation remains well above the 2% target. A hot jobs print could accelerate hike bets. Bulls need a soft-but-not-weak labor market and Broadcom to echo Nvidia's AI visibility. S&P 500 Q2 earnings pace: +34.5% YoY.
